author: 1v1Me_
body:
I didn't know if you could see the one I archived on accident Ok so I just saw that I was banned for ban evading wackaflackaflame. Did avicus just get something for IP address or something because u banned me and my little brother. Wacka is my friend who I bought this account off him. And I go to his house sometimes
and play mc. My brother (kdefender03) doesn't know he is banned yet until he plays later. So I have 2 emails. One my brother uses and one I use. I get them confused sometimes and signed in one time on his account. It probably saved the ip or whatever and is the same
as wackas. Kyle (wacka) is one of my best friends. He has appealed more times them I can count. He loves This server and so do I.
this is the only server I play on. He has like 11 in game days played and I have made like 14. I have made so many friends like mlg porky and vlad. I'm just asking to please  unban me and kdefender03. Thanks and sorry for your troubles. P.s I'm writing this on my phone cause I'm at the doctors

replies.body:
Hello,

"Wacka is my friend who I bought this account off him". This is against the EULA, and you shouldn't do this. Could you clarify your story? It makes little sense. Also, why would you go too his house to play minecraft if he is banned?

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.

replies.author: 1v1Me_
replies.body:
Ok sorry, I bought this account a while ago before I knew any EULA stuff, Im sorry for that. I guess I just didn't want to spend 25 dollars when I could get one for 5 you know. I didn't think it would be a big deal. And you probably know the server Mineplex right. Well we entered a tournament there and we were practicing. Then I got board of The Bridges so I started to play Avicus.

Sincerely 
-1v1Me

Edit: Have you ever gone through a rough times with money and finances. My dad got laid off and didn't find a job for a while. Next year is high school, I have to find a way to get money for books/lunch/supplies. I don't have the money to spend 25 dollars on a mine craft account. Im sorry, People are prob going through ruffer times then me and I know that. I have a house, heat, food on my table and lots of other great things. I just don't have the xbox ones or good gaming counsels. I love this server so much I have used (not wasted) 14 days on it. I have made friends that I can't meet in real life but are better then real life friends. 

Thanks Again
-Zack
